title: The Lighthouse House — Currituck

title: Big Bay Point Lighthouse Bed & Breakfast

title: Cove Point Lighthouse Keeper's House

title: Wings Neck Lighthouse
subtitle: Iconic Cape Cod lighthouse on its own private peninsula

title: Lighthouse with Hot Tub — San Juan Islands Views
subtitle: Island-dotted Pacific panoramas from your own lighthouse

subtitle: Cozy A-Frame beside the lake with Great Lakes pine forest

subtitle: Pine forest A-Frame on 1.5 acres bordering national forest

subtitle: Sleek mountain A-Frame with views of Pikes Peak

subtitle: Hot tub, private beach, and docks on a North Idaho lake

subtitle: Montana river cabin steps from world-class fly fishing
description: A stunning A-Frame right on the banks of the Clark Fork River in the Cabinet Mountains wilderness of western Montana — steps from world-class fly fishing and miles from any crowd. Pure Montana escape.

subtitle: Waterfront A-Frame steps from Timberline Lodge skiing

subtitle: Creekside A-Frame retreat in the Cascades foothills

subtitle: Cascades A-Frame with hot tub and mountain panoramas

subtitle: Backcountry yurt with a 0.8-mile hike to four Apostle Islands in view

subtitle: River glamping at the foot of Shenandoah National Park

subtitle: Texas Hill Country glamping at 4.96 stars

subtitle: 1 of 23 best glamping spots in the US — authentically intimate

subtitle: Romantic yurt on the Georgia-Tennessee ridge with Chattanooga views

subtitle: Secluded 80-acre retreat with canoe and hiking trails

title: Luxury Yurts on Lake Grapevine
subtitle: Lakefront glamping minutes from DFW

subtitle: A yurt wrapped in Hudson Valley waterfalls and forest

subtitle: Acadia's peaceful shore far from the Bar Harbor crowds

subtitle: Scenic sleepers for city slickers in the Catskills
description: Retro-chic Airstreams tucked into the Catskill Mountains, minutes from Woodstock and an hour from Manhattan. Hike, ski Hunter Mountain, or simply decompress in one of the country's most beloved creative communities.

subtitle: Hillside sanctuary above the Ohio gorges with a luxury interior

description: A newly remodeled modern getaway in Palm Springs featuring a salt pool/spa, EV charger, and minutes from downtown. The quintessential mid-century Palm Springs experience with full EV charging capability.

description: Gateway to Rocky Mountain National Park — full hookup sites with elk grazing past your rig at dawn. Trailheads within walking distance. The most convenient base camp in Colorado.

description: A charming tiny houseboat moored in Portland Harbor with stunning views of the working waterfront. Fall asleep to the gentle rocking of the tide and wake to lobster boats heading out at dawn. A one-of-a-kind Maine experience.

title: Stargazing Bliss in Dome with Sauna & Hot Tub
subtitle: Sleep under a billion stars near Zion
description: A brand-new geodesic dome nestled in the serene landscapes of Glendale, Utah. Panoramic views of the surrounding desert, a private sauna, and a hot tub under the stars. One of the darkest skies in the American Southwest.

title: Redwood Treehouse Retreat Near Muir Woods
subtitle: Suspended among ancient giants with a creek below
description: A high-design sanctuary suspended in a grove of ancient redwoods just minutes from Muir Woods. Soaring wood beams, expansive windows, and forest views in every direction. Wake to birdsong and fall asleep to the sound of a bubbling creek.

title: Point Robinson Lighthouse — Keeper's Quarters
subtitle: Historic keeper's quarters on Vashon Island
description: A restored lighthouse keeper's quarters on Vashon Island — accessible only by ferry. Restored to capture the historic character of the original building. Stunning Puget Sound views and whale watching opportunities.

title: The Big Buffalo — 1894 Historic Hotel
subtitle: Old West character in downtown Buffalo, Wyoming
description: Originally 15 rooms of the historic Capitol Hotel (1894), now three connected apartments on Main Street in Buffalo, WY. Old West character throughout — original water closet, back staircase built for "Ladies of the Night." Pool on premises.

title: Historic DC Firehouse Penthouse Loft
subtitle: First African American fire company, built 1884 — as seen on Netflix
description: Built in 1884 as the first fully African American fire company in Washington DC. Renovated by a world-famous interior designer. 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, ~3,000 sq ft. As seen on Netflix Stay Here Season 1.

title: The Green Mountain Chapel
subtitle: Old church repositioned into 3BR with stained glass
description: A 19th-century church repositioned into a 3-bedroom home. Vaulted ceilings, original stained glass windows, and brand new finishes throughout. 5 minutes from Magic Mountain, 20 minutes from Okemo and Stratton.

title: Pelican Bay Lighthouse
subtitle: A privately owned, working lighthouse on the Oregon Coast
description: A privately owned, working lighthouse perched over Brookings, OR with captivating Pacific Ocean views. The Keeper's Suite is lofted on the upper floor. A legacy family home brimming with warmth and coastal charm.

title: Hobbit House on Cedar Bluff
subtitle: Underground geodesic dome with lake views
description: A 4-bedroom underground geodesic dome with a 4-foot tower topped with a clear dome for natural sunlight. Copper sink, open living room, and lake views on 3 acres. The most whimsical family stay in Arkansas.

title: Hanksville Red Rock Cave Home
subtitle: Blasted into the cliff by a Utah cowboy in the 1980s
description: Built in the 1980s by local cowboy A.C. Ekker — literally blasted into the red rock cliff. Recently remodeled with modern comforts. A true desert cave experience near Capitol Reef National Park.

title: Private Sage Canyon Cliff House
subtitle: Built into red rock near Mesa Verde
description: Built right into a red rock cliff wall in a private canyon alcove in McElmo Canyon. 40 minutes from Mesa Verde National Park, 20 minutes from Cortez. Sweeping canyon views and a truly unique Southwest experience.

title: HouseBoat + Sauna + Fire Pit
subtitle: Sacramento Delta waterway experience
description: A houseboat with a private sauna and fire pit on the Sacramento Delta waterways. Explore miles of channels by kayak, then sauna and stargaze by the fire. Great for groups.

title: Stylish Houseboat — Mill Valley
subtitle: Floating home in the iconic Sausalito community
description: A stylish floating home in the iconic Sausalito/Mill Valley houseboat community. Minutes from San Francisco by ferry. Stunning bay views and the unique experience of living in one of America's most famous floating neighborhoods.

title: Renovated Tugboat on Private Lake
subtitle: Farm animals, fishing, swimming on 142 acres
description: A renovated tugboat floating on a private 8-acre lake with an island, on 142 wooded acres with 5+ miles of hiking trails. Meet Theo the Cow, sheep, goats, and ducks. Kayaks, SUP boards, and fishing gear included.

title: Modern Dome in Shawnee Forest
subtitle: Fiber internet, 6-person hot tub, tall pines
description: Nestled deep in Shawnee National Forest among tall pines. A 6-person hot tub, 500 Mbps fiber internet, outdoor TV, fire pit table, and rainfall shower. The most complete dome experience in the Midwest.

title: Geodesic Dome on 22 Acre Forest
subtitle: Outdoor shower, soaking tub, vineyard nearby
description: Escape to 22 forested acres near Helen, Georgia. An outdoor shower and soaking tub, hiking access, and a vineyard nearby. Set in the vibrant arts district of historic Sautee Nacoochee Valley.

title: Fox Wood Dome — Cedar Hot Tub
subtitle: Magazine cover-worthy Ozark dome
description: As seen on the cover of 417 Magazine. A 100% climate-controlled dome with an outdoor cedar soaking tub, hammock, and rolling Ozark forest views. 15 minutes to the charming Victorian town of Eureka Springs.

title: SkyDome Hideaway
subtitle: First luxury dome in DFW
description: The first luxury geodesic dome in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Nestled on a hill among oak trees with a hot tub and outdoor shower. Perfect for couples and honeymooners within an hour of DFW.

title: Romantic Mountain Escape Dome
subtitle: Skylight stargazing in the Smoky Mountains
description: A skylight dome in the Smoky Mountains where you stargaze from bed. Creek sounds below, mountain views above, and a private hot tub outside. Minutes from downtown Sylva and Harrah's Cherokee Casino.

title: The Copper Fox Treehouse
subtitle: Luxury in the Green Mountains
description: A beautifully crafted treehouse in the Green Mountains of Vermont with stunning fall foliage views and high-end finishes throughout. The most romantic treehouse in New England.

title: Stargazing Planetarium Treehouse
subtitle: Airbnb OMG! Fund winner with Beaver Lake views
description: One of 100 winners of the worldwide Airbnb OMG! Fund contest. A planetarium-themed treehouse overlooking Beaver Lake near Bentonville, Arkansas — with a stargazing experience literally built into the design.

title: Treehouse at Bliss Ridge Farm
subtitle: Best views in Vermont from a working farm
description: Perched on a working Vermont farm with sweeping mountain and valley views. A truly one-of-a-kind New England experience — wake up to roosters, farm animals, and the most spectacular Green Mountain scenery.

title: Bide In The Trees — Luxury Skydeck Treehouse
subtitle: Perched 20 feet up with a private skydeck
description: Perched over 20 feet in the air with a private skydeck for stargazing. Luxury amenities throughout this Georgia treehouse — one of the most beautifully crafted in the Southeast.

title: BaseCamp TreeLoft
subtitle: Cozy seclusion with a private hot tub
description: The first of two treehouses at BaseCamp — designed for cozy seclusion, romance, and rest. Nestled in the Missouri woods with a private hot tub and string lights. One of the highest-rated treehouses in the Midwest.

title: Wander Bend Retreat
subtitle: Cascade Mountain panoramas, ski access
description: Panoramic views of the Cascade Mountains from every window. This Wander property in Bend has a private hot tub, smart home tech, and Starlink WiFi. Mt. Bachelor ski resort is 30 minutes away.

title: Wander Folly Beach
subtitle: Direct beach access near Charleston
description: Every room faces the Atlantic at this Wander property on Folly Beach. Direct beach access, smart home technology, and Starlink WiFi. Charleston's world-class dining and history are 30 minutes away.

title: Wander Broken Bow Trails
subtitle: Deep in the Ouachita National Forest
description: Deep in the Ouachita National Forest, this Wander property has hiking trails starting from the back door, a private hot tub, and a fire pit under the darkest skies in Oklahoma. Starlink WiFi keeps you connected.

title: Wander Friday Harbor
subtitle: Island escape accessible by ferry or floatplane
location: Friday Harbor, San Juan Island, Washington
description: San Juan Island is accessible only by ferry or floatplane — and this Wander property sits at the heart of it. Watch orca whales from the deck, explore the island by bike, and work remotely with Starlink WiFi.

title: Wander Arch Cape Forest
subtitle: Old-growth forest meets Pacific coast
description: Nestled in an ancient old-growth forest on the Oregon Coast, this Wander property offers ocean views, a private hot tub, and Starlink internet. Walk directly to the beach through towering Sitka spruce trees.

title: Wander Joshua Tree Starfall
subtitle: Desert luxury under a billion stars
description: Floor-to-ceiling glass walls face the open Mojave desert at Joshua Tree National Park. A stargazing deck, heated pool, and Starlink WiFi make this Wander property the ultimate desert escape. The park entrance is minutes away.
